title: Speaker’s last-minute withdrawal triggers protest at unveiling of Kanayi’s sculpture in Kasaragod

ai.summary: Protesters in Kasaragod demanded artist Kanayi Kunhiraman unveil his sculpture after Speaker Radhakrishnan withdrew last-minute from the inauguration event.

facts.claim: Speaker Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan failed to turn up at the last minute
facts.quote: Speaker Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan, who was scheduled to inaugurate the installation, failed to turn up at the last minute.

facts.claim: Protesters demanded Kanayi Kunhiraman unveil the sculptures
facts.quote: When the organisers proposed Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan as an alternative chief guest, the protesters demanded that Mr. Kunhiraman himself unveil the sculptures.

facts.claim: P. Sudhakaran expressed disappointment over the speaker’s last-minute withdrawal
facts.quote: P. Sudhakaran, co-author of Kanayi’s autobiography, openly expressed disappointment over the speaker’s last-minute withdrawal.

facts.claim: Documentary filmmaker A.T. Mohandas removed the ribbon to oppose the change in plan
facts.quote: Documentary filmmaker and art historian A.T. Mohandas removed the ribbon tied across the square to register his opposition to the change in plan.

ai.background_note: The protest occurred in Kasaragod, a district in Kerala, following the Speaker's last-minute withdrawal from the sculpture unveiling event.
